276:     """Representation of HomematicIP Cloud notification light."""
277: 
278:     _attr_supported_features = LightEntityFeature.EFFECT
279:     _effect_list = [

281:         OpticalSignalBehaviour.BLINKING_MIDDLE,
282:         OpticalSignalBehaviour.FLASH_MIDDLE,
283:         OpticalSignalBehaviour.OFF,
284:         OpticalSignalBehaviour.ON,
285:     ]
286: 
287:     def __init__(self, hap: HomematicipHAP, device, channel: int, post: str) -> None:
288:         """Initialize the notification light entity."""
289:         super().__init__(hap, device, channel, post)
290: 
291:     @property
292:     def effect_list(self) -> list[str] | None:
293:         """Return the list of supported effects."""
294:         return self._effect_list
295: 
296:     @property
297:     def effect(self) -> str | None:
298:         """Return the current effect."""
299:         return self._func_channel.opticalSignalBehaviour
300: 
301:     @property
302:     def is_on(self) -> bool:
303:         """Return true if light is on."""
304:         return self._func_channel.on
305: 
306:     async def async_turn_on(self, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
307:         """Turn the light on."""
308:         # Use hs_color from kwargs,
309:         # if not applicable use current hs_color.
310:         hs_color = kwargs.get(ATTR_HS_COLOR, self.hs_color)
311:         simple_rgb_color = _convert_color(hs_color)
312: 
313:         # If no kwargs, use default value.
314:         brightness = 255
315:         if ATTR_BRIGHTNESS in kwargs:
316:             brightness = kwargs[ATTR_BRIGHTNESS]
317: 
318:         # Minimum brightness is 10, otherwise the led is disabled
319:         brightness = max(10, brightness)
320:         dim_level = round(brightness / 255.0, 2)
321: 
322:         effect = self.effect
323:         if ATTR_EFFECT in kwargs:
324:             effect = kwargs[ATTR_EFFECT]
325: 
326:         await self._func_channel.async_set_optical_signal(
327:             opticalSignalBehaviour=effect, rgb=simple_rgb_color, dimLevel=dim_level
328:         )
329:

331:         """Turn the light off."""
332:         await self._func_channel.async_turn_off()

335: def _convert_color(color: tuple) -> RGBColorState:
336:     """Convert the given color to the reduced RGBColorState color.
337: 
338:     RGBColorStat contains only 8 colors including white and black,
339:     so a conversion is required.
340:     """
341:     if color is None:
342:         return RGBColorState.WHITE
343: 
344:     hue = int(color[0])
345:     saturation = int(color[1])
346:     if saturation < 5:
347:         return RGBColorState.WHITE
348:     if 30 < hue <= 90:
349:         return RGBColorState.YELLOW
350:     if 90 < hue <= 160:
351:         return RGBColorState.GREEN
352:     if 150 < hue <= 210:
353:         return RGBColorState.TURQUOISE
354:     if 210 < hue <= 270:
355:         return RGBColorState.BLUE
356:     if 270 < hue <= 330:
357:         return RGBColorState.PURPLE
358:     return RGBColorState.RED
